name: doses
description: Every dose taken, at its time: the health.medication.dose events as a log, so an occasional or as-needed medicine reads back without standing as a regimen. The meds projection is the current regimen; this is what was actually taken. Version 3 names the same type as version 2 and only rewords this description. Version 2 named the type with its third segment; version 1 named it health.medication-dose.
